_readme: Provenance manifest for every hardcoded real-world fact in this repo's calculators. Each entry names the real external source, its real update cadence, when it was last verified against that source (by whom/what commit), whether an automated check exists, and that check's actual verified status. Update this file in the same commit as any data fix. Do not add an entry with a fabricated or unverified source - if a fact's real source hasn't been checked, mark automated_check.status as "missing" and last_verified.method as "never independently verified", don't invent a plausible-looking entry.

entries.description: Every wage figure across the whole site - national percentile curve, state medians, city medians, and job-category medians.

real_source.name: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS), May 2025 release
real_source.real_cadence: annual - BLS publishes OEWS in the following spring for the prior May reference period (e.g. May 2025 data released ~April 2026)

last_verified.commit: 6fc563d, f6012dc, f183ec8, d9e6574 (4 commits, one per dataset tier: national/state, city, homepage cross-link, job categories)
last_verified.method: manual audit - downloaded the real BLS OEWS May 2025 national/state/MSA/SOC-code data files directly, matched all 181 cities via component-based real BLS MSA title matching

automated_check.status: BROKEN since creation - has never once worked
automated_check.behavior_as_designed: Was meant to fetch BLS series LEU0252881600Q (a Current Population Survey quarterly median-weekly-earnings series) weekly, and if the national figure moved by more than $1,000, proportionally scale every percentile, state median, and city median by that same ratio and auto-commit.
automated_check.actual_finding_2026-09-08: Series ID LEU0252881600Q does not exist - confirmed by calling the real BLS API directly, which returns 'Series does not exist for Series LEU0252881600Q'. Checked the full run history via `gh run list`: every single run since the workflow's creation on 2026-05-27 (roughly 15 runs, weekly, over 3+ months) has hit this exact error and silently exited 0 with a soft 'transient error' Slack message, meaning it has never once fetched real data or made a commit. It has been reporting a green checkmark in GitHub Actions the entire time while doing nothing.
automated_check.additional_design_flaw: Even if the series ID were fixed, this design would still be wrong: BLS CPS national median weekly earnings and BLS OEWS per-city/per-occupation wages are two different surveys that don't move proportionally to each other. Proportionally scaling the real, independently-sourced city and category data (from the Aug 31 fix) off an unrelated CPS statistic would silently drift that data away from reality with every triggered run, not toward it - a new, mechanically-generated form of the same fabrication problem this manifest exists to prevent.
automated_check.recommendation: Retire this script's scaling logic entirely rather than patch the series ID. Replace with a real annual re-fetch of the actual BLS OEWS release (matching the real May-data/following-spring cadence), diffed against the current file and flagged for review rather than auto-committed - not a weekly proportional-scaling job against an unrelated series.
